_note: Constants of a1_frame_march.py's stages (strip, kernel) and the S31 twin's readings used as the comparison column, kept as DATA with class and provenance per the validation numeric ratchet (R28).

record_readings_s31.note: X-CHTW derive of record (S31 night, (161,81), the fan_axi cut at 1.5 mm on the smoothing-spline contour): p_w/p_0 and M at the 20/34/41/48 percent truncations, the record column of the stage prints

wall_class.note: the Chutkey twin's oracle classes: 3 percent on p_w/p_0 (the paper's printing + RANS), 2 percent on M (X-CHTW T-5/T-6)

angelino_blend_mm.note: the Angelino streamline replaces the digitised contour for the first 3 mm from the foot and is ramped into it over the next 1 mm (the digitised chords scatter +-8 deg over the first 3 mm)

streamline_step.note: RK4 step (frame units, 1e-5 R_lip = 0.3 um) of the Angelino streamline

dense_wall_points.note: dense sampling of the contour for the frame rotation (5 um)

pm_fan_points.note: the corner wave's tabulation in speed, as CT.fan_sonic

brentq_q_window.note: the speed bracket (in a*) and tolerance of the Mach-to-speed root, as a1_inlet_angle_opt.fan_at

station_clustering.note: wall stations from the cut: first spacing 0.05 half-heights growing by 6 percent per station up to the uniform spacing

strip_defaults.note: stage strip: uniform-line Mach, cut in half-heights, stations, rows (the S32 negative of record ran 145/41 and 255/61)

kernel_defaults.note: stage kernel: the cut at z 0.5 of the kernel's stretched variable (its reach, S32 log 10.2), the plug-wall throat radius posed 1.5 separations (inside the domain, R_c 3 with a straight cowl), the lip 0.1 half-heights upstream of the cut, the foot-curvature read over 0.3 half-heights; the corner fan's 25 rays (uniform in speed from the lip's to the ambient's) x 12 points to the cut

frame_defaults.note: stage frame: the S31 twin's coarse rung (81,41) and the dense wall sampling of rotate_case

lb_transition_d.note: the L-b posed plug wall: the throat parabola up to 0.4 separations from the throat plane (beyond the cut at z 0.5 = 0.245 d), a cubic Hermite transition to the Angelino wall reached at 1.5 separations
